text_block_list.text:
I hear voices coming from the trainer's 
office. Peeking through the crack in the 
door...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ngh......! Ugh... Why won't my body move, 
no?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Contender El—! If you don't 
hurry, it's gonna be a three-count, you 
know?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El! Don't give up, deee-su!! We're going 
to do a lot of training today, too...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El... has to get so much stronger!!

She was spurring herself on, but her body 
looked like it was already on the verge of 
collapsing...

To keep fighting from here on out, maybe 
we should take another look at our race 
schedule...
